english.note: Use this general term when the wrapping material may be paper, plastic, or another substance.
Use this when referring specifically to materials such as paper, plastic, or cardboard used for packaging.

examples.english: When shipping goods, choose the right wrapping materials; cardboard boxes and bubble wrap both work.
examples.traditional: 寄貨嗰陣，要揀啱包裝材料，紙箱同氣泡紙都得。

examples.english: Cardboard boxes and plastic bags are common packing materials.
examples.traditional: 紙箱同膠袋都係常用嘅包裝材料。
